name: Mahou Senshi Fairy Bullet
original_name: 魔法閃士フェアリーバレット
source:
This is a world that is inhabited by both mankind and "fairies".

With the blessings from fairies, invisible beings that bestow all sorts of graces to people, mankind was able to develop civilizations.

However, the blessings can sometimes give rise to distortions. When the power of human desires runs out of control, a monster called "Libidosis" will be born.

In order to combat the threats that Libidosis possess, "Fairy Agency" a specialized security organization that gathers individuals with powerful blessings was born. And in this organization is a member named Shitou Soratarou.

As a member of Fairy Agency, Soratarou works to protect people. However, Shitou Soratarou is just an alter ego of Gertrud. His real identity is a candidate for successor to "Kaiten Council" (World Changing Council), a powerful force of the dark world.

Gertrud hid his true identity and spends his time as a student as Soratarou. He then became acquainted with Kaitou Kazuha and Nishizato Takayuki who belong to Fairy Agency as well and later their friend Sakimoto Yumeka. 

One day, Yumeka found out that an extraordinary and powerful blessing resides within her.

Using the power of this blessing, Yumeka transformed herself and decided to use her power to fight for people's happiness and peace as "Fairy Bullet"

Meanwhile, Soratarou who has witnessed Fairy Bullet's power began to make his move in order to acquire her power so that he could secure his position as the successor to Kaiten council.

[Translated from [url=https://www.route2.co.jp/Triangle/Products/FairyBullet/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
这是一个人类与“妖精”共同居住的世界。

正是在仙女这种无形的存在给予人们种种恩惠的加持下，人类才得以发展文明。

然而，祝福有时会引起扭曲。当人类欲望的力量失去控制时，一种名为“性欲”的怪物就会诞生。

为了对抗性欲所带来的威胁，聚集了拥有强大祝福的个体的专门安全组织“妖精机关”诞生了。而这个组织中有一位成员，名叫石头空太郎。

作为妖精机关的一员，空太郎致力于保护人们。然而，石头空太郎只是格特鲁德的另一个自我。他的真实身份是黑暗世界强大势力“回转委员会”（世界改变委员会）的继任者候选人。

格特鲁德隐藏了自己的真实身份，以空太郎的身份度过了学生时代。之后，他结识了同样属于Fairy Agency的怪盗和叶和西里隆之，以及后来他们的朋友崎本梦香。

有一天，梦花发现自己体内蕴藏着一种非凡而强大的祝福。

利用这种祝福的力量，梦花改变了自己，决定用自己的力量为人们的幸福与和平而战，成为“子弹仙子”

与此同时，目睹了子弹妖精力量的空太郎开始采取行动，以获取她的力量，从而确保自己作为回转议会继承人的地位。

[翻译自[url=https://www.route2.co.jp/Triangle/Products/FairyBullet/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
